== Description ==
'''SHA-3''' is the one of the many Shadow entities found within the [[Shadow Challenge]] and the [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier.

== Behavior ==
'''SHA-3''' will spawn in the center of the room upon opening the door, and after a few seconds he will rush forward and break 10 doors, meaning that you'll need to go forward to avoid getting killed by Void Wall. '''SHA-3''' also has a chance of spawning [[SHA-2]] upon breaking the doors, and a much rarer chance to spawn [[SHA-55]] or [[SHA-60]]

== Strategy & Tips ==
* Simply approach the main room's door and sprint forward when '''SHA-3''' rushes, and pay attention for [[SHA-2]] when you're in a safe area, or for [[SHA-55]]/[[SHA-60]]'s sounds.
* Avoid sprinting against the door and wait for '''SHA-3''' to break it, because if '''SHA-3''' opens a large room, this room might take a bit longer to load, which will cause you to fall outside of the map, or get stuck in the ground, causing [[SHA-2]] to kill you if it spawns, or one of the other two if by chance they spawned.

== Trivia ==
* There seem to be a bug with '''SHA-3''' that, if it open a room with a locked side room, '''SHA-3''' won't break any doors past this room. (at least in the [[Section D]] Derelict room that have the [[Unnamed Sector]] entrance in the side-room).
* '''SHA-3''' can invade During any Perfection Event.
** this can be proven deadly if it happens while in [[Red Rooms]], since entities that are on a timer may still spawn.

== Lore ==
* '''SHA-3''' was the one who infected [[SHA-30]].
